verification: stored generators + per-item predictions written during fits

baselines.R_lex: rank-2 unembedding-difference swap operator (phase8c_res_rlex.py, name_vectors.npz) evaluated at every position class x layer under C1/C3/C7
baselines.identity: identity operator under the full battery (8C robustness lesson: fitted-R passes that identity also clears carry no positive evidence)

conditions.C1: disjoint-vocabulary transfer (fit-vocab R evaluated on transfer-vocab episodes), mandatory
conditions.C2: unavailable, not waived — G-path failed the joint behavioural gate; cross-path transfer untestable within Item 3 scope
conditions.C3: group laws: involution defects R12^2, R23^2; braid R12R23R12 = R23R12R23; 3-cycle closure — activation-weighted, as 8C
conditions.C4: nontriviality + support tests: registered name-embedding-difference-span lt test AND as-run readout-span variant, both reported
conditions.C5: causal patch-and-continue at the SINGLE best position-class x layer selected on CALIBRATION only; one GPU session; procedure and seeds frozen here: patch resid_post at the selected position with R-transported source vector, continue generation, transport_agree vs 10 shuffled-fit nulls + identity-fit null, tau = 0.95 quantile of null agreement; seeds 20260807
conditions.C6: episode-local content/role probes, availability floor 0.9, availability-gated (as 8C)
conditions.C7: joint-permutation transport (MANDATORY for H_role-at-binding): R fit on in-place P orbits must transport correctly on joint-permutation P episodes at the same position class x layer; thresholds from the same matched null machinery

maximal_achievable_claim: P-path binding-site role code; task-generality untested.
position_class_note: entity_mention_carry: 3 per episode (per-slot); fact_final: per-clause finals; query_arg: 1; answer: 1 (continuity with 8C). Fits are per position-class x layer; for multi-token classes the class instance aligned to the permuted slot is used (slot s for R acting on slot pairs), defined by manifest order.
power_note: Holm at m=88: smallest-p cell must clear alpha/m=5.68e-04. With 10 shuffled nulls + quantile thresholds per cell, per-cell null exceedance is calibrated at the 5% quantile rule as in 8C; the grid-level correction is applied to the descriptive table. The VERDICT rule is not multiplicity-dependent: H_role-at-binding requires joint satisfaction of ALL mandatory conditions (C1, C3, C4, C7) at the SAME position-class x layer cell, which is a conjunction, not a sweep.

reporting_grid.multiple_comparison: Holm across the full 4x22=88 grid, alpha=0.05

ridge_protocol.form: phase8c_lib dual-form R = Y^T (XX^T + lam I)^{-1} X on raw activations (no centering)
ridge_protocol.lambda_selection: calibration split only, transfer-err criterion as 8C
ridge_protocol.nulls: matched-regime shuffled-pair fits x10 (frozen seeds 0..9) + identity null, identical sample count and lambda grid per position-class x layer
ridge_protocol.thresholds: calibration null quantiles per position-class, frozen before test reads; same quantile rules as results/phase8c/committed_config.json

sets.in_place: frozen 84f2e54d... P cells (disc for fits, gate for probes/sanity)

splits.rule: by base problem, orbit-complete, same as 8C: disc P bases split 50/50 calibration/test after strict-orbit filter; joint set split by the same base ids (joint bases are new; split 75/75 per vocab by sorted base_id parity)

verdict_space.H_retrieval_everywhere: no probed position carries a transportable operator distinguishable from identity/R_lex
verdict_space.H_role_at_binding: C1+C3+C4+C7 all pass at >=1 non-answer position-class x layer cell, with R_lex and identity both failing where fitted R passes
